Frequently Asked.

Call or text 540-205-6500 if you need help deciding which program fits your situation.
Do I have to be a Virginia resident?

No. The November 15 class is open to eligible adults age 21+ regardless of state residency. Virginia residents and nonresidents use different application paths for the Virginia permit.

Do I need to bring a firearm?

No. A firearm is not required for the November 15 Virginia classroom course.

Can I bring ammunition?

No. Ammunition is not permitted in the classroom.

Is there live fire in this Virginia class?

No. The November 15 Virginia course does not include live fire. Florida and Maryland programs are scheduled separately because their requirements differ.

Where is the class?

The classroom will be in the Fredericksburg / Spotsylvania area. Exact location information is sent to registered students after minimum enrollment is reached.

What if the class does not reach 10 students?

You may transfer the deposit to the next scheduled class or request a refund.
